decision: Test real SST boundaries with an auxiliary full-key arena
why: Prefix compression prevents independent entry reads without reconstruction
result: Use decoded immutable blocks; report extra key bytes

decision: Pin LMDB native dependency to the prepared-data version
why: Fresh resolution chose 0.2.6 and failed with VersionMismatch; readpath uses 0.2.5
result: Initial smoke rejected; rebuild before measurements

decision: Use private LMDB copies and normal reader locking
why: Read-only NO_LOCK open returned EINVAL; copying preserves sources and matches the existing control transaction settings

decision: Commit the read transaction that opens LMDB DBI
why: Dropping it aborts the opening transaction and invalidates the DBI; supersedes the NO_LOCK explanation
result: Root-cause fix; no timings accepted yet

decision: Accept only fully verified interleaved processes with gated counters
why: Shared host contention requires same-run controls and startup must not pollute events
result: Five-trial suite running; first bulk MPHF smoke passes threshold provisionally

decision: Apply the brief's bulk-hit p50 cutoff of 0.8x LMDB
why: Primary gate compares five-trial median raw p50; also report paired worst-trial and e2e ratios to expose sensitivity
result: Bulk passes all these interpretations; normal layout remains a separate result

decision: Attribute the result to MPHF plus decoded blocks
why: Bulk has one SST so routing is degenerate; normal preserves 84 SSTs and three levels; no sorted-decoded-arena control isolates MPHF alone
result: GO can justify the combined design only

decision: Label negative results as 64-gap missing-ID workload
why: Reversed per-agent IDs cluster the misses and make ordered-index leaves hot
result: Do not generalize to uniformly scattered interior misses

decision: Record failed source opens and copy provenance
why: Early LMDB smoke opened the original READ_ONLY and failed; accepted runs use private reflink-or-copy datasets and fresh locks
result: All source data will be hashed against private data after final timings

decision: Qualify CPU isolation because unrelated work uses sibling CPU 9
why: No experiment task uses CPU9, but per-CPU accounting shows background busy time; leave browser and kernel workers untouched
result: Numeric cutoff can be assessed; quiet-sibling isolation is not achieved

decision: Finish all trials, closing floor, provenance and self-review
why: Primary cutoff passes with large margin; retain representation, miss-shape, TLB and sibling qualifications
result: 100 accepted processes, zero errors; 91 source/copy files equal; GO for V2 prototype with quiet-sibling confirmation outstanding
